_comment: PLACEHOLDER dialogue for chapter X. speaker=display name, portrait=roster path_name (real art as stand-in), pos=left|center|right, background=assets/backgrounds id. A line with `choices` shows buttons; a choice applies `set_flags` and optionally `goto`s another scene, else ends the scene.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Chapter X opens at the Leaf Hub. Worlds are bleeding together.

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Whoa — where even are we? Everything feels... stitched together.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] A corruption spreads across the universes. Head to the Mist Village — something waits there.

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Got it. Let's move! (Mist and the Market are now open on the map.)

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER — REPEATABLE] Want to drill some fundamentals while you're here? You can revisit this any time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER — IDLE] The Leaf Hub is quiet. Nothing new right now.

lines.speaker: Sakura
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] You made it back! But the corruption followed you home — the Hub is under attack!

lines.speaker: Sakura
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] We held them off. The Shrine has revealed itself to the east — that must be the source.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] The Mist Village is shrouded and hostile.

lines.speaker: Rival
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Turn back, outsiders. This fog belongs to us now.

lines.speaker: Sasuke
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] We're not asking permission.

lines.speaker: Rival
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] ...The corruption... it was using us. Go — warn the Leaf.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Objective updated: return to the Leaf Hub.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER — IDLE] The mist has cleared. The village is calm now.

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER — SIDE QUEST] Please! Bandits took my cart. Help me and I'll owe you one.

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] What do you say?

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER — HELPED] Bless you! Take this — and my thanks. (Reward flag set; a real unlock would be granted here.)

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER — DECLINED] ...I see. Heroes, they said. Hmph.

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] My hero returns! The cart's back in business thanks to you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER — IDLE] The market bustles. Nothing needs you here right now.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] The Convergence Shrine pulses with corrupted light.

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] So this is where the worlds are tearing open.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] End it here, and Chapter X is complete. (This is a placeholder finale.)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER — LOCKED] The Shrine is sealed. Something must happen at the Hub first.
